title: 5k menus from the New York Public Library’s Buttolph Collection (1880-1920)
summary: The Pudding presents an interactive data visualization exploring 5,000 historical menus from the New York Public Library's Buttolph Collection spanning 1880-1920, revealing dining trends and cultural shifts during America's Gilded Age and early Progressive Era through engaging visual storytelling.
problem_solved: Transforms dense archival menu data into an accessible, interactive visual experience that reveals historical dining patterns.
why_valuable: Bridges archival preservation with modern data journalism, making historical food culture discoverable and engaging for general audiences.
